response.sql: WITH filtered_ab AS (SELECT * FROM advancedbehavior WHERE peercorr >= 0.149), matched_records AS (SELECT ab.translink, tr.ordertypedist, COUNT(*) as record_count FROM filtered_ab ab INNER JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg WHERE tr.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ab.translink, tr.ordertypedist), total_by_ordertypedist AS (SELECT ordertypedist, SUM(record_count) as total_count FROM matched_records GROUP BY ordertypedist) SELECT mr.translink, mr.ordertypedist, mr.record_count, CAST(mr.record_count AS REAL) / tbo.total_count as fraction FROM matched_records mr JOIN total_by_ordertypedist tbo ON mr.ordertypedist = tbo.ordertypedist ORDER BY fraction DESC LIMIT 10;
